explanations.13: Object.entries() converts a plain object into an array of [key, value] pairs so we can loop over it with .map().
explanations.15: The ?? operator means 'use the right side if the left side is null or undefined', so if counts.helpful doesn't exist, treat it as 0.
explanations.18: This calculates the percentage of helpful votes; the ternary operator prevents division by zero when there are no votes at all.
explanations.23: The .sort() uses || (or) to break ties: if two articles have the same helpful count, sort them by total votes instead.
explanations.67: The inline style uses a template string to set the width dynamically based on the ratio prop, creating a filled progress bar.
explanations.99: The URL is built by combining siteUrl with slug using a template string to create links to individual articles.
explanations.143: .trim() removes whitespace from the token input before submitting it to avoid issues with accidental spaces.
explanations.172: The siteConfig object from useDocusaurusContext() contains the site's base URL and other Docusaurus configuration.
explanations.179: This comment explains the priority order for loading the token: first check the URL hash, then localStorage, then show empty (form).
explanations.184: window.location.hash.slice(1) removes the # symbol from the URL hash so we get just the token part.
explanations.195: encodeURIComponent() converts the token to a URL-safe format so special characters don't break the query parameter.
explanations.196: A 403 status means the token is invalid, so we clear the stored token and show an error instead of crashing.
explanations.212: The [apiUrl] dependency means fetchData will be recreated if apiUrl changes, preventing stale closures.
explanations.218: This effect re-runs whenever token changes, triggering a data fetch to keep the dashboard in sync with the current token.
explanations.223: This calls fetchData immediately after setting the token, but the effect on line 216 will also call it, so the token is fetched twice here.
explanations.233: If data exists, compute the summary statistics; otherwise data is null, so stats will be null and we won't render the dashboard yet.
